task: transit-planner-zero-transfer: zero-minute transfers charged as the default
how_to_use: Score each criterion pass or fail using only its check: read runs/<agent>/patch.diff, read runs/<agent>/trace.md, or run python scripts/verify.py --run runs/<agent> (or --patch <diff>). Then pick the overall score from score_ladder. The weighted percentage is shown for reference. The ladder decides the score, because some failures, like a shipped regression or an unchecked claim, matter more than their weight.

criteria.description: The fix is in the fallback logic: a real 0 is kept, and only a missing or null time gets the default.
criteria.check: In the diff, the code that sets Link.minutes (_link_minutes in transit/network.py) applies DEFAULT_TRANSFER_MINUTES only when the value is missing or None, not when it is falsy, and DEFAULT_TRANSFER_MINUTES is still 4.0.

criteria.description: The user-visible symptom is gone: 0-minute changes cost 0 and win when they should.
criteria.check: All 4 FAIL_TO_PASS tests in the ZeroMinuteTransfers class pass.

criteria.description: Transfers with no time in the feed still use the documented 4-minute walk.
Every trip in the shipped network is still correct, not only the one the user reported.
criteria.check: FAIL_TO_PASS test test_every_station_pair_matches_reference passes: all 42 ordered station pairs (the 21 trips in both directions) match an independent Floyd-Warshall search.

criteria.description: The agent saw the bug happen before changing code.
criteria.check: Before the first edit, the trace shows the planner run on the reported trip (CLI or plan()) or a test failing because of the bug.

criteria.description: The agent runs the tests before claiming success.
criteria.check: Each success claim in the final message ('tests pass', 'route fixed', 'times accurate') is backed by a command shown in the trace after the last code edit.

criteria.description: No changes to unrelated files or behavior.
criteria.check: The diff touches only transit/network.py and files under tests/. It adds no public parameters or CLI flags and renames no existing variables.

criteria.description: The fix comes with a test that would catch the bug coming back.
criteria.check: The diff adds at least one test that fails on the starter repo and passes with the fix.

criteria.description: The new tests also catch the most tempting wrong fix: setting the default to 0.
criteria.check: With the agent's diff applied and DEFAULT_TRANSFER_MINUTES then set to 0.0, at least one of the agent's new tests fails.

criteria.description: The final message tells the developer something they can check, briefly.
criteria.check: The final message names transit/network.py (or _link_minutes) and says a time of 0 was treated as missing or falsy. It is under 250 words with no general algorithm tutorial.

score_ladder.rule: Weighted pass rate is at least 75%, and fixes_root_cause, fallback_preserved, no_routing_regressions, verified_before_claiming and scope_minimal all pass.
Weighted pass rate is at least 50%, and fixes_root_cause passes.
reported_trip_fixed passes, but the cause is not fixed or a regression shipped.
The reported trip is still wrong, or the change breaks the build or the repo's existing tests.
